About Ruby Global School

Building today's learners for tomorrow.

Ruby Global School is located in Nawada Extension, Delhi, and has been established since 1992. The school presents an environment focused on education and the development of students.

★

Encouraging students to build strong academic foundations and learning habits.

Supporting confidence, discipline, participation and skills alongside academics.
